title: JMAP Email/get: x-usenet-ipfs-verifications property
description:
Add verification results as a property on JMAP Email objects.

What: crates/mail/src/email/types.rs + get.rs (wherever Email/get properties are assembled)

Property name: x-usenet-ipfs-verifications (following X- convention from existing x-usenet-ipfs-sig)

Value type: Vec<VerificationEntry>
  pub struct VerificationEntry {
      pub r#type:   String,          // 'usenet-ipfs-sig' | 'dkim'
      pub key_id:   Option<String>,  // sha256:<hex>
      pub result:   String,          // 'pass' | 'fail' | 'no-key' | 'dns-error'
      pub detail:   Option<String>,  // 'domain=example.com selector=s1'
  }

Algorithm:
1. In Email/get handler, after fetching article by CID, call store.get_verifications(&cid).
2. Map to Vec<VerificationEntry>; include in Email object if non-empty.
3. If verify_store is None or query returns empty: omit property (or return empty array — pick one and document it).
4. Advertise in JMAP session capabilities or Email property list.

Defensive rules:
- Query failure: log warn, return empty array, do not fail the Email/get request.
- Property is additive: clients that do not request it do not receive it.
